snippet.title: Last Report - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Here's your look at gameplay and the unsettling world of Last Report in this trailer for the upcoming dark horror game, where you play as a night shift park ranger. While monitoring the camera footage, you start noticing strange events. Uncover the terrifying secret of the National Park. Something moved in the window, but don’t worry it’s probably just another deer, right? Last Report will be available on PC via Steam on July 11, 2025.
